message: feat(unified): U03 共同owner、对象、地址与跨消费者租约
rulings: One device mutex is explicitly injected into ResourceTable; lease serial belongs to device context, preventing cross-table token collisions. Common adapter tests use actual byte-copy implementation with stubbed hardware boundary, not real DMA.
Linux fd/ioctl provider wiring remains U06 and actual kernel audit U23. U03 validates shared C lifetime/legacy owner/lock gate without claiming kernel or board PASS.
Atomic allocation rollback uses bounded slot indices, avoiding a 3KiB temporary ref array on kernel stack.
